system.description: Also at 5th Level, you take your skill with chakra network refinement and extend it to your meditations and short downtimes. When you and allied creatures would spend at least 10 uninterrupted minutes resting, you can lead a group meditation where you can roll 1d8, regaining the result as chakra for yourself and all participating allied creatures. A creature can only benefit from this feature once per short rest. This becomes 2d8 at 11th and 3d8 at 17th levels.

activities.label: Group meditation
activities.text: You and participating allies (select their tokens); once per Short Rest each.
